title: Identification of Women With Severe Insulin Resistant Syndromes of Genetic Origin Among Patients With "Classic" Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS)
official: Identification of Women With Severe Insulin Resistant Syndromes of Genetic Origin Among Patients With "Classic" Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS)
summary: Diagnostic case-control study (1 case for 2 controls). Inclusion of patients with severe insulin resistance syndrome of genetic origin, then inclusion of controls: patients examined for PCOS in day hospital with matching age (+/- 5 years) and Body mass index (+/- 5kg/m2).
